message.content:
This vertical-format illustration appears on a magazine cover with a blue background and a thin red border. At the top, white text reads "TEMPO" below a header saying "Wawancara Khusus Prijadi Praptosuhardjo". Small white text identifies the date as "EDISI 18-24 Juni 2001". Larger yellow text in the center reads "Serangan Balik Gus Dur". 

The illustration depicts a seated man with brown, textured skin on the right. He wears a black cap, glasses with thick white frames, a grey suit, and a purple tie. His arms are crossed. From his chest, a red mechanical spring arm extends leftward, ending in a large red boxing glove. This glove punches another man in a red suit who is flying backward, limbs splayed. Below the man in red, another man in a brown suit is also falling head-first toward the bottom-left corner. Both falling figures have exaggerated, grimacing facial expressions. The seated man on the right maintains a calm, closed-eyed expression. Small red shoes are visible beneath his grey suit. A barcode and price "Rp 10.500" are at the bottom.
